meta.title: Obsidian DTB - Dynamic Theme Background
meta.description: Dynamic Theme Background (DTB) - Multi-source dynamic wallpaper plugin for Obsidian: Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Wallhaven, 360 Wallpaper, custom & local images.
meta.keywords: Obsidian, wallpaper, background, plugin, Unsplash, Pexels, Pixabay, Wallhaven, 360 Wallpaper, dynamic, theme background
meta.ogDescription: Multi-source wallpapers, smart scheduling & visual tuning for an inspired Obsidian workspace.

features.title: Key Features
features.subtitle: An elevated wallpaper experience crafted for Obsidian

multiSource.title: Multi-source Library
multiSource.desc: Unsplash, Pixabay, Pexels, Wallhaven + custom API & local folders—flexibly combine and curate.

visualTuning.title: Visual Tuning
visualTuning.desc: Adjust blur, brightness, saturation, hue & more—theme-friendly and dark/light aware.

smartRotation.title: Smart Rotation
smartRotation.desc: Time windows, interval auto-change, command palette quick switch, minute-level scheduling.

greatUx.title: Great UX
greatUx.desc: Async loading, caching, default presets, batch ops & shortcut commands for fast workflows.

performance.title: Performance Minded
performance.desc: Optimized rendering & caching for minimal impact on editor responsiveness.

roadmap.title: Roadmap
roadmap.desc: Weather integration, theme packs, video / audio / AI backgrounds, mobile refinements.

installation.title: Installation
installation.subtitle: Pick a method below. Once enabled, jump to Quick Start to configure rotation & sources.

marketplace.title: Community Marketplace
marketplace.note: Currently in Obsidian review queue. Until approved, use BRAT or Manual. Track PR in obsidian-releases.

brat.title: BRAT (Beta)
steps:
BRAT → Add beta plugin → Paste repo URL:
https://github.com/sean2077/obsidian-dynamic-theme-background
brat.note: Fastest way to try latest code before Marketplace approval.

manual.title: Manual Install
steps: Download latest main.js, manifest.json, styles.css from Releases
manual.note: Use for pinned versions, air-gapped envs, or manual audits.

installation.helpText: Need help? See the README or report an issue.

quickstart.title: Quick Start
quickstart.subtitle: Already installed? In three short steps you'll have smart rotation running.

step1.label: STEP 1
step1.title: Add Sources
step1.desc: Add local images or enable API providers (Unsplash / Pixabay / Pexels / Wallhaven / Custom).

step2.label: STEP 2
step2.title: Set Rotation
step2.desc: Choose interval + optional time windows (morning / day / night) for contextual change.

step3.label: STEP 3
step3.title: Control & Enjoy
step3.desc: Use status bar clicks or Command Palette (dtb) to switch, save & fetch.

statusbar.caption: Status Bar Snapshot
statusbar.title: Status Bar Quick Control
statusbar.hint: Daily interaction happens here or via the command palette.
statusbar.tip: Tip: assign hotkeys for even faster switching

quickstart.done: You're set: sources + rotation + controls active.
